items.title: Collect an audio Holotape
items.detail: Fast travel to the Rusty Pick and turn right as soon as you enter. There is an Audio Holotape on a barrel next to a lantern.

items.title: Collect Deathclaw eggs
items.detail: Check the two nests directly outside the entrance to Abandoned Waste Dump in The Mire. Server hop if none found or if more are needed.

items.title: Collect Toilet Paper
items.detail: Fast travel to The Whitespring Resort Exterior and head right, behind the main resort building. Enter the red brick maintenance building. Inside, a table can hold both soap and toilet paper.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: If your C.A.M.P. has a Games Cupboard, take a Board Game from it. It produces Blast Radius, Autopsy, Catch the Commie, Rad Poker and Unstoppables! board games.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Enemy
items.detail: Join a public event that spawns many Legendary enemies, such as Eviction Notice, Radiation Rumble or Uranium Fever.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Wavy Willard's Water Park in the Toxic Valley for a reliable Scorched spawn. A quick circle around the park can turn up to a dozen Scorched.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture at Nuka-World On Tour
items.detail: Fast travel to Nuka-World On Tour, equip the Camera from your Pip-Boy weapons slot, and take a picture there.

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Fast travel to your own C.A.M.P. or take over a workshop. Then from the C.A.M.P. build menu, place any small decoration or C.A.M.P. pieces, such as a floor or stair piece.

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: The quickest option is to just go to your stash or ammo storage box and pull some out. Or equip the Ammosmith perk and craft any ballistic ammo plan at a Tinker's Workbench.

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft Bulk Steel at a Tinker's Workbench at your C.A.M.P. or use the one at the Whitespring Resort. Requires Steel scrap and Plastic.

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft Bulk Wood at a Tinker's Workbench at your C.A.M.P. or use the one at the Whitespring Resort. Requires Wood scraps and Plastic.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center and cripple a Super Mutant's Arm or Leg by aiming at the Arm or Leg with a rifle.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine, where up to 25 Mole Miners spawn in and around the mine (18 inside).

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Any bladed melee weapon counts: Combat Knife, Bowie Knife, Cultist Dagger, Pitchfork, Fire Axe, Chainsaw, or Ultracite Terror Sword. Only the final hit has to land with the blade.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps and Loose excavator power armor mod boxes and other junk that contains Black Titanium at any workbench.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any NPC vendor. The Whitespring Resort is one good spot with several vendors.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Double rewards for both SCORE progress and in-game currency earnings.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special celebration event marking the anniversary with various activities and rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers a rotating selection of rare plans and recipes at discounted prices.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation rates and increased caps rewards during gameplay.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutated variants offering enhanced rewards and challenges.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: All experience gained is doubled, accelerating character progression and farming.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72)
events.description: Major patch introducing world pets feature and launching Season 27: You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Special scorched creatures spawn with holiday-themed rewards including gifts and exclusive items.
